header: Main CPU: boot, custom I/O chips, the per-frame IRQ (sprite copy, coins,
timers, main/sub frame handshake), attract mode, the game-mode task
scheduler at $FEB5, scoring and all sound requests (the sub CPU cannot
reach the sound RAM). DP is $10 everywhere after boot.

E000.name: reset_main
doc: Power-on / watchdog reset. Boot sequence:
1. hold sub + sound CPUs in reset (SRESET), let the I/O chips run,
mask the IRQ, DP = $10, S = $1600;
2. 56XX command 1 (read switches) with arg F, 58XX command 0;
3. fill the tilemap with $00,$20 pairs, clear $0400-$1FFF (kicking
the watchdog on every word);
4. starfield off, no flip; 62XX bytes 8-15 = 4..$0B;
5. custom-chip check: 56XX mode 8 (sum of args 9-15 = 7 x F = $69
-> nibbles 6,9), 58XX mode 5 (must give F,F), 62XX bytes 1-3
must read F,E,1. A failure hangs at $E0C5 with D = $2031/2/3
('1'/'2'/'3' = which chip; nothing is drawn, only the code in D);
6. release SRESET and handshake: write $11 to $6040 (sound) and
$0800 (sub), wait until each answers $22 (their ROM checksum is
done);
7. write $0000 to $7820-$782F (lands on the IRQ-off latch, harmless);
8. 56XX/58XX command 0, then 56XX mode 1 (switches) / 58XX mode 4
(DIPs); copy switches to $1006-$1009; decode the DIP switches
into coinage, lives, difficulty, cabinet and bonus settings;
9. service switch on -> service_mode; else pulse FRESET, program
the coinage into the 56XX (mode 2) and go to game_init ($C296).

E0C5.name: boot_chip_error
doc: Custom I/O chip check failed: hang (watchdog resets the board).

E1DE.name: program_coinage
doc: Pulse FRESET (resets the 56XX coin/credit counters), write the
coinage from $1025-$1028 to 56XX args 9-12 and run mode 2 once,
then draw the frame border tiles.

E212.name: fill_16_words
doc: Store X at ,U++ sixteen times.

BE25.name: delay_65536
doc: Busy wait: 65536 passes of a watchdog-kicking loop (about 26 frames).
D is preserved. Used between custom I/O chip commands at boot.

C000.name: irq_main
doc: Main CPU vblank IRQ (also the SWI/FIRQ/NMI vector, never used).
- kick the watchdog and clear/mask the IRQ latch;
- operator stats display (DSWA SW1:6), demo-sound gate;
- DSW service switch on -> jump to service_mode (never returns);
- 56XX credits >= 10 in the tens nibble -> coin_jammed (hang);
- round-advance DIP on -> round_select loop (P1 up = next stage);
- re-enable the IRQ latch early (the CPU's I flag still masks it
until RTI), update the play clock and the 1UP/2UP blink;
- copy the flip flag; clear $1E31+2n for each occupied formation slot n;
- coin inserted (56XX nibble 2): coin sound; during attract,
abort the demo and restart attract at attract_loop (the stack is
abandoned; attract_loop never returns);
- copy main-owned sprites from the shadow buffers ($0EE2-$0F33 +
banks $1600/$1E00) into sprite RAM slots 40-63, mirrored when the
screen is flipped; park the unused slots (all 0);
- starfield scroll direction; frame counter $1016/$1015;
- frame rendezvous with the sub CPU: wait for $10AF = $11 (sub
finished its frame), answer $22, RTI.

C0AB.name: irq_copy_sprites
doc: Copy the main CPU's sprites (shadow $0EE2-$0F33, bit 7 of the
flag byte = in use) to sprite RAM from slot 40 ($0FD0) up.

C163.name: round_select
doc: Round-advance DIP switch: show the start stage (BCD of $1106) and let
P1 up step it; loops inside the IRQ until the switch is off.

C1B9.name: coin_jammed
doc: 56XX reports an impossible credit count: print COIN JAMMED on the top
row and hang (kicking the watchdog) until reset.

C1D6.name: add_score
doc: Add A (BCD, units of 10 points) to the current player's score
($09B0 P1 / $09B3 P2, 3 BCD bytes, least significant first), with
DAA carries; then update the high score and redraw the score as
tiles, suppressing leading zeros. Skipped while $115F is set.
In: A = BCD points.

C253.name: update_hiscore
doc: If the score at X beats the high score $09B6-$09B8 (most significant
byte first), copy it and redraw it at the top of the screen.

C287.name: bcd_hi_to_char
doc: A = tile code of the high BCD digit of A (falls into bcd_lo_to_char).

C28B.name: bcd_lo_to_char
doc: A = tile code of the low nibble of A: '0'-'9', and 'A'-'F' above 9
(the font is ASCII-ordered).

C296.name: game_init
doc: After boot: 56XX to coin mode (4), blank the tilemap, print the
1UP / HIGH SCORE / 2UP header, enable the IRQ, run the 62XX init
sequence (modes 1, 2, 0, 3, each followed by CWAI to wait a frame),
fill the high-score table, set the default high score and turn the
starfield on; then discard pending starts and enter attract_loop.

C417.name: attract_loop
doc: Attract mode main loop (also re-entered from the IRQ when a coin
arrives during the demo, and after a game). Prints CREDIT n; with
credits it goes to the push-start screen; otherwise it advances
the attract timer $1029/$102A/$102B and dispatches on
$102B & 3 through attract_phases.

C467.name: draw_credit
doc: Print 'CREDIT nn' on the bottom row from the 56XX BCD credit
nibbles (tens digit blank when zero).

C492.name: attract_demo
doc: Attract phase 1: start the demo game (attract flag $09F4 = 1).

C49F.name: attract_demo2
doc: Attract phase 3: demo game at stage index 2 with the dual fighter
sprites pre-loaded.

C4DA.name: push_start_1p
doc: One credit: leave attract, show the push-start screen, allow
1P start only and wait for a start (56XX nibble 3 = credits used).

C639.name: print_string_r
doc: Print the zero-terminated string at U from tile address X going
right (X -= $20 per character). Attributes untouched.

C670.name: push_start_2p
doc: Two or more credits: push-start screen for 1 or 2 players.

C866.name: attract_phase0
doc: Attract phase 0.

CAA9.name: attract_phase2
doc: Attract phase 2.

CCD0.name: start_game_1p
doc: One-player start (56XX says 1 credit used; also the demo). Sets
lives, clears scores and the playfield, places the player and the
reserve ships, plays the start tune (sound 0) and waits for it to
end, loads the demo input script when in attract mode, then enters
the game-mode scheduler (task_dispatch_sync).

CDFF.name: start_game_2p
doc: Two-player start: both players get the lives setting.

CF4F.name: task_move_player
doc: Scheduler task: move the player's ship ($1600 Y / $1601 X in the
sprite shadow) from the joystick nibble ($6804, or $6806 for player
2 on a cocktail cabinet). In the demo the stick comes from a
scripted input table (duration, stick byte) at $09F0-$09F2.

D000.name: demo_input
doc: Demo: step the recorded input script; at its end ($F0) stop the
demo and return to attract_loop.

D07A.name: irq_timers
doc: Called by the IRQ: play clock, 1UP/2UP blink colours.

D0C6.name: update_play_clock
doc: BCD clock: $09F8 frames (0-59), $09F9 seconds, $09FA minutes,
$09FB hours (0-23). Shown by the operator stats display.

D150.name: task_end_frame
doc: Last entry of every task list: wait for the next IRQ (CWAI), reset
the stack, restart the current mode's list at task 0.

D15B.name: task_next_mode
doc: End of mode 0: clear the frame counter, wait a frame, game_mode + 1.

D168.name: task_player_fire
doc: Fire button edge (56XX nibble 5 bit 1, or the demo script): put a
shot sprite in a free slot of $0EA2..($10D3) and request the shot
sound.

D71B.name: task_stage_start
doc: Mode 0: starfield, clear per-stage state, stage number
$1035 = player stage, reduced below 60 (60+ repeat 30-59); print
'PARSEC nn' (and GAME OVER in attract mode). Challenging stages
(challenging_stages) print CHALLENGING STAGE and switch to mode 7.

D860.name: challenging_stages
doc: Stage indexes (0-based) of the challenging stages: 2, 7, 12, ...
(PARSEC 3, 8, 13, ...; verified on the oracle)

DF19.name: sound_all_off
doc: Clear every sound request $6040-$605F and state $6060-$607F.

DF27.name: sound_demo_gate
doc: Silence the attract sounds unless the demo-sounds DIP is on (keeps
the coin sound $6056).

E21A.name: task_results
doc: Mode 8 task: stage results screen, sub-state $1160 through
results_steps.

E85C.name: print_string_attr
doc: Print the zero-terminated string at U from tile address X going
right (X -= $20 per character), writing attribute B to each cell.

F4A5.name: load_stage_params
doc: Load the stage's parameters. $1035 = stage (reduced to < 60 by
subtracting 30); tables indexed by difficulty $1004 and stage give
the enemy groups, speeds and the formation layout copied to

FCDF.name: operator_stats
doc: Called every IRQ. With SW1:6 on (58XX $6816 bit 2, 'unused' in MAME)
and P1 fire held, show the bookkeeping counters on screen: the BCD
play clock $09FA-$09FB and the counters $09D6-$09DF. Also blanks a
column every 8 x 256 frames.

FEB0.name: task_dispatch_sync
doc: Entered once per game start: tell the sub CPU ($0800 = $33), then
fall into task_dispatch.

FEB5.name: task_dispatch
doc: The main CPU's game-mode scheduler. A = game_mode ($102F), B =
task index ($1030): jump through mode_task_lists[A][B]. Every task
ends with INC <$30 / JMP task_dispatch, so each frame runs the
whole list of the current mode in order; the last task
(task_end_frame) waits for the IRQ and restarts the list. Tasks
change $102F to switch modes. The sub CPU runs the same scheme on
its own lists with $102F and $107A.

FEC0.name: mode_task_lists
doc: One task list per game mode 0-9 (pointers).

FED4.name: tasks_mode0
doc: Mode 0: stage start.

FF96.name: tasks_mode6
doc: Mode 6: stage clear.

FFA6.name: tasks_mode7
doc: Mode 7: challenging stage.

FFC0.name: tasks_mode8
doc: Mode 8: challenging stage results.

FFCA.name: tasks_mode9
doc: Mode 9: high score check and name entry.

AFBE.name: task_hiscore_entry
doc: Mode 9 task: high score entry, sub-state $11FF through
hiscore_steps (0 check, 1 draw screen, 2 enter name).

B49F.name: hiscore_check
doc: Compare the player's score (tile digits) with the five table
entries at $0900 (16 bytes each), shift the lower entries down and
insert; pick the rank music (sound 3 for 1st, 4 otherwise).

B6F6.name: service_mode
doc: Service / test mode (DSW service switch, checked at boot and in
every IRQ). Re-initialises like reset, then: RAM test $0000-$1FFF
and $6040-$63FF with rotating patterns, custom-chip check, ROM
checksums of $A000/$C000/$E000 (error digit 1-3 at tile $0306),
sub/sound handshake and their checksum results, then shows the DIP
settings and runs the sound test (stick selects, fire plays).
Leaving the switch resets through reset_main.

B77C.name: fill_tilemap_00_20
doc: Fill $0000-$03FF with $00,$20 word pairs.

BA2F.name: print_string
doc: Print the zero-terminated string at X to tile address U going
right (U -= $20 per character). Returns X past the terminator.

BD7B.name: service_loop
doc: Service mode loop: service coin held -> crosshatch test grid until
released; service switch off -> reset_main; otherwise any change of
the stick/button nibbles steps or plays the sound test ($100A).

BE37.name: easter_egg
doc: Hidden screen in the service mode: shown when the sound test is on
$09 with the stick up-left, or on $19 with the stick left, while
start 1 + P1 fire are held (56XX mode 1: $6801 stick, $6803 = 5).
Draws the bitmap at $BE78 as '0' tiles and hangs.

BFEF.name: checksum_A000
doc: Checksum adjust: the byte sum of $A000-$BFFF is 0 (tested at
boot or in the service mode).

DFFF.name: checksum_C000
doc: Checksum adjust: the byte sum of $C000-$DFFF is 0 (tested at
boot or in the service mode).

FFEF.name: checksum_E000
doc: Checksum adjust: the byte sum of $E000-$FFFF is 0 (tested at
boot or in the service mode).

FA7D.name: task_bonus_life
doc: Extra ship check: compare the current player's score with the bonus
settings ($1001-$1003) through bonus_steps ($1124 P1 / $1125 P2).

EAA4.name: task_stage_events
doc: Mode 1 task: on the stages listed at $EACC run the stage event
steps (index $116E).

D676.name: task_stage_clear
doc: Mode 6: stage cleared. Reset the formation flags and enemy sprites,
silence, next stage for the current player, stage-clear sound 5
(sound 2 on the stages listed at $D6E8), back to mode 0.

D915.name: task_player_hit_check
doc: Build a box around the player ($10C6-$10C9) and test the sprite
shadow entries $0ECE-$0F13 against it (enemy shots and enemies).

comments.E002: hold sub + sound CPUs in reset
comments.C067: coin during the demo: wait for the sub
comments.C158: wait for the sub CPU's frame
comments.C296: 56XX coin mode for the rest of the game
comments.CE7F: wait for the tune to finish

E01C: Clear the tilemap and all shared RAM.
E064: Chip self-check: 56XX mode 8 and 58XX mode 5 with args 9-15 = F.
E0C7: Start the sub and sound CPUs and wait for their checksums.
E0F5: Read the switches and DIP switches.
C0AB: Sprite copy: main-owned sprites to sprite RAM slots 40-63.
C0C3: Flipped screen: mirror Y ($E0 or $D0 for 2-tall sprites) and X.
C111: Disable the remaining slots up to $1000.
C125: Starfield direction from the frame counter and $1170.
C163: Round-advance DIP: show the start stage, P1 up steps it.
CE15: Start tune while the ships fly in.
CEC4: Demo input script: $AADA, or $ACBC for the stage-2 demo.
D04C: but nothing reaches it: dead code or reached through RAM.
E5DC: Disassembles as code (prints two strings with print_string_attr)
F924: Disassembles as code; F921 jumps over it: disabled routine?

data.comment: bonus life: first, second, every (x 10000, BCD)

0800.name: sub_handshake
0800.comment: boot: $11 main->sub, $22 sub done; $33 at game start

09F0.name: demo_timer
09F0.comment: frames left for this demo input

100A.name: var_100A
100A.comment: service: sound number; stage start: temp

1016.name: frame_counter
1016.comment: +1 per main IRQ; also the game's randomness

6040.name: snd_request
6040.comment: sound n: main writes 1 (sound: boot handshake at +0)
